column2: Use your image generation tool to create ONE image, as wide and as high resolution as possible (landscape), saved as sky_night.png. Subject: a hyper-realistic, ethereal NIGHT photographic sky for a video game skybox: a vast calm moonlit sea of soft clouds below the horizon line, a bright full moon low above the cloud sea casting cool silver light on the cloud tops, a deep navy-to-indigo starry sky with a faint milky way, thin luminous cirrus, and distant monolithic brutalist megastructures rising out of the cloud sea far away with tiny cyan and magenta window lights and thin neon light lines, softened by haze. The horizon is level and sits at about 80% of the image height from the top. No text, no people, no aircraft, no lens flare, no vignette.
